notes: A207969_conjecture k n : exists z : Z, expCoeff (bseq k) n = z, bseq k n = 5 F(n)^(2k), expCoeff = coefficients of exp(sum b x^n/n) via A(0)=1, (n+1)A(n+1) = sum b(j+1)A(n-j). Route: Gauss congruences b(m p^a) = b(m p^(a-1)) mod p^a (p != 5: Frobenius in Z[phi] (frob) + dvd_sub_pow_of_dvd_sub gives Lucas congruences (lucas_gauss), 5F^2 = L(2n) - 2(-1)^n, closure under products, divide by unit 5^(k-1); p = 5: 5^j | n => 5^j | F(n)); dwork: b(n) = sum_{d|n} d c(d); expCoeff_int_of_euler: truncated Euler product prod (1-x^d)^(-c(d)) in Z[[X]] with the same log-derivative. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: reading exp(...) as the series with A(0)=1 and x A' = (sum b x^n) A. A207970 is the k = 3 case (A207970_int).
